1.1.1 - 1 (PRRP Risk Screening Toolkit was endorsed by the Government of Tonga and is now a requirement for all Project Proposal Applications (for projects greater than 500,000 Tongan Paanga). The toolkit has also been used to screen all projects funded under the new National Infrastructure Investment Programmes. (2) Supported RDFD, MOF, Tonga in application of risk screening tool on project proposals of the Ministries of Infrastructure and Agriculture and Planning Department under Prime Ministers Office.
1.1.2 - 0 (Although no progress - LoA’s (Letter of Agreement) with 3 Ministries across 2 countries ( Kiribati and Solomon Islands) were signed. These LoAs stipulate the commitment the Government side in mainstreaming risks into budgeting and planning. The LoAs also stipulates that the project will support creation of new positions that will support the integration of risk measures in budgeting and planning) 1.1.3 - 0
1.2.1 - 6 (Risk management measures were developed and costed for 5 MRMDDM projects, these included relocation of one project and utilisation of alternative materials to enhance project resilience. 32 successful proposals submitted with risk assessment undertaken and incorporated (varying degrees) in activities, workplan, budget, M&E indicator 1.2.2 - 3 (1.) Supported development of Fiji MRMDDMs SDP and launched (26 Nov). ii.) Developed a risk informed project proposal template and process, which was used by grantees of the small grants initiative, and is now being adopted by the Fiji MRMDDM) 1.2.3 - 3 (Risk screening assessments for 9 community projects finalised. GIS mapping conducted to support risk screening process. Report on Field visit finalised and submitted to MRMDDM for consideration (2) 2 successful proposals submitted with risk assessment undertaken and incorporated (varying degrees) in activities, workplan, budget, M&E indicators (3) Initial introduction and awareness provision around the concept of RID and how this can be incorporate into project design, budget, M&E and implementation (including GSI components) through the SGI and the proposal development training and process that has been undertaken. This has been with 5 x country coordinators and NGO, CSO and CBOs across 7 countries.
1.3.1 - 2 (Solomon Islands Ministry of Women informed project design of Ministry of Agriculture food security initiative. Budget submission was made and funding awarded. (2) Incorporation of GESI in Gov4Res Small Grants initiative. The GESI team held trainings and developed learning materials for SGI grantees and for proposal development. Learning materials shared on Solevaka platform) 1.3.2 - 1 (Risk maps produced for MRMDDM pipeline projects were developed. Discussions between MRMDDM GIS Officer and UNITAR Commonsensing project staff is ongoing, regarding access datasets on disaster and climate change risks, which can be used for future planning of projects (2) GIS and IT Equipment for GIS Officer (Gov4Res funded position) purchased and deployed to MRMDDM
2.1.1 - 0 2.1.2. - 3 (Gov4Res hosted parliamentary training with Fiji Natural Resource Committee on Risk Informing Development. The project developed a parliamentary risk screening checklist which was used by the Natural Resource Committee in their scrutiny of forestry, agriculture and fisheries sectors (2) The project delivered training to all Fijian MPs on SDG Budget Analysis. (3) SDG Budget Analysis for the Tongan Parliament conducted in partnership with Effective Governance Units Parliament Development Team. 2.2.1 - 1 (Budget scrutiny findings discussion workshop held with Tonga CSOs) 2.2.2 - 0
3.1.1 - 2 (Multiple learning sessions held between Fiji and Tonga Ministry of Finance on RID integration processes. This work is part of promoting dialogues on the impact of RID. Peer to peer exchange initiated through the Gov4Res board meeting, between representatives from 6 countries, partners and donors. Countries shared their experiences in integrating risk into PFM, local government and access and use of climate finance (3) Peer-reviewed the Samoa PEFA Climate Report. The review recommendations were incorporated within the PEFA report and approved by Samoa Government. Report has been published on PEFA website
3.2.1 - 3 ((1)Contributed to a global UNDP discussion on Risk informed development, with the intention of informing the new UNDP SDP. There is increasing recognition that RID could become an formidable offering from UNDP, and Gov4Res are one of the first teams programming as such. (2) Contributed to the development of UNDP DRR-CCA Mainstreaming Toolkit by providing feedback on the draft. The team also made a submission of a RID Case Study in Fiji, which specifically demonstrates the processes of risk informing development projects using a bottom-up narrative (3) Published Climate Finance Effectiveness Research Paper, with recommendations presented at 2021 FEMM
3.2.2 - 1 (Formalisation of partnership agreement – the board endorsed the request of the Pacific Islands Forum for Gov4Res to be a partner in undertaking climate finance work through the Technical Working Group on Climate Finance and PFM)

1.1.1 - 2 (Climate Change typology for Climate budget tagging & Risk Screening tool for all CAPEX Projects of MRMDDM) 1.1.2 - 2 (Budget circular - confirmation of establishment of Resilience & Development Finance Division under Tongas Ministry of Finance) (Endorsement of Climate Budget Tagging typology that will be rolled through Budget Circular Process under Fijis Ministry of Economy) 1.1.3 - 2 (1. For Fiji, M&E Assessment were conducted for CAPEX Projects. 2. Risk Screening tools integrated through Monitoring & Planning Cycle for MRMDDM)
1.2.1 - 2 (Parliamentary submissions for proposed 2021 National Budgets by MRMDDM as well as MWCPA which was directly supported through Gov4Res) 1.2.2 - 2 (Solomon Islands Ministry of Livestock and Ministry of Health, commenced the development of model farms in 6 Provinces to reduce nutritional disorders) (Gov4Res support to MRMDDM Fiji with the design of the Strategic Development Plan, 2020-2030) 1.2.3 - 2 (1. Fiji - Gov4Res supported MRMDDM with the TC Yasa response to directly affected communities, this was done through direct budget support and contributes to the well being of affected communities. Gov4Res also supported MRMDDM with data consolidation Project to leverage additional resources for TC Yasa Response. 2. Solomon Islands - Gov4Res supported the development of 6 model farms in 6 Provinces to diversify food sources and provide food security which demonstrates increased cost efficiencies and saving and improving the well being of the community. )
1.3.1 - 1 (1. Fiji - MRMDDM through the monitoring & evaluation exercise have identified the need for RID in Budget Planning Processes and which is augmented in the upcoming Budget submissions) 1.3.2 - 2 (1. Fiji - MWCPA currently responsible for Women & Children have been supported to integrate RID in Budget Planning Processes 2. Solomon Islands - Ministry of Women supporting Ministry of Agriculture & Ministry of National Planning with revision of Risk Screening Toolkits to strengthen evidence based risk data for planning & budgeting at Divisional and Sectorial level.)
2.1.1 - 0 (Currently in consultation with office of the Auditor General to conduct Performance audit for SDG reporting and Voluntary National Reporting for 2021) 2.1.2. - 0 (The Project commenced after first budget analysis process and the next budget planning process will commence in January 2021. Ongoing consultations as indicated in 1.2.1 and 1.3.2 reflects the same.) 2.2.1 - 1 (1. Fiji - Submission of the Revised Climate Change Budget Bill in November 2020 and 2 rounds of Public consultation regarding the Bill. 2. National Oceans Policy had 2nd round of consultation which provided an opportunity for Public scrutinisation throigh face to face consultation and legal submissions, these included ocean related development investments) 2.2.2 - 0 (Efforts have been made to engage CSOs, Gov4Res will build on this in 2021)
3.1.1 - 2 (1. Fiji - Cabinet speech by Minister for MRMDDM. 2. Fiji - Development of the Strategic Resilient Development Policy initiated by MRMDDM in 2020) 3.2.1 - 2 (1. Climate change paper on effectiveness of Climate Change Finance was presented by Gov4Res in partnership with Forum Secretariat at the Forum Economic Ministers Meeting. 2. Gov4Res engaged with PIANGO in relation to the delivery with resilience training in Tonga) 3.2.2 - 1 (Gov4Res supported the development of the FRDP standards of excellence for implementation using the Projects building blocks model.)
